description: This PHP source file defines the AnnouncementApiController class within the Goteo project's API controllers. It manages API endpoints related to announcements, including validation and updating announcement properties such as the 'active' status, with appropriate permission checks and exception handling.

classes.name: AnnouncementApiController
classes.description: Controller class handling API requests related to announcements, including validation and property updates, extending a base API controller class.
